'''Template:RTB''' is a version of Template:RT which displays a blank tile of any color (use it for rock tiles).  See [[:Template:RT]] for usage notes and examples.

== Usage ==

<pre><nowiki>
{{RTB|<color>}}
</nowiki></pre>
